reviews.text: The cream has a rich yet comfortable texture and provides good hydration. It keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜質地豐盈但又舒服，保濕力好。全日皮膚都保持水潤。

reviews.text:
Using this one in my morning skincare step!
Love it and will continue to use it 🙂‍↕️
Also using toner and serum from this rice series
reviews.zh: 我將呢款加入我嘅早上護膚程序！好鍾意，會繼續用 🙂‍↕️ 同時都用緊呢個米系列嘅爽膚水同精華。

reviews.text: This product absorb super well into my skin and gives me such a natural glow. I would really recommend pairing it with the serum, but it’s just as good on its own.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品超級快就吸收，而且俾到我好自然嘅光澤感。好建議搭配精華一齊用，但單用其實都好正。

reviews.text: The packaging was well-packaged and shipped, the item is intact and has not been used yet, I look forward to the results of the next use.
reviews.zh: 包裝好實，運送得宜，貨品完好無缺，仲未用過，好期待下次使用嘅效果。

reviews.text: i love the gel texture as it doesn’t feel too thick on my face, but still provides moisture. i use it daily and definitely feel that my skin is smoother than before. the lightweight texture also helps it absorb faster and it doesn’t feel like anything is on my face. however people with dry skin might want a thicker formulation. overall i would recommend this product!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個 gel 狀質地，搽上面唔會太厚，但又做到保濕。我日日都用，皮膚明顯比之前滑咗。輕盈嘅質地亦都令佢吸收更快，搽完完全唔覺有嘢喺塊面。不過乾性肌嘅人可能需要更厚重嘅配方。整體嚟講我會推薦呢款產品！

reviews.text: This set looks really nice in person. The serum feels lightweight and the cream has a soft, clean scent. I tested a little on my hand and it made my skin feel soft and moisturized. I can’t wait to use it regularly for brightening.
reviews.zh: 呢個套裝實物睇落好靚。精華感覺輕盈，面霜有種柔和、乾淨嘅香味。我喺手背試咗少少，皮膚即時變得柔軟又水潤。好期待日日用嚟提亮膚色。

reviews.text: Cannot say much yet, but the texture is really nice. No weird smell or anything, it also did not clog my pores or make my skin feel uncomfortable. Any brightening creams need a while to work - so shall see after a few weeks.
reviews.zh: 暫時仲講唔到好多，但質地真係好正。冇奇怪嘅味道，亦都無塞毛孔或者令皮膚感到唔舒服。任何提亮產品都需要時間先見效——過多幾星期再睇下點。

reviews.text:
I really love this rice moisturizer!!!
Very nice for my super duper dry skin and also it makes my face to get more brighter🫶🏻
I also using rice serum too
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款米保濕霜！！！對我超級乾燥嘅皮膚好啱用，而且用完塊面更加有光澤🫶🏻我仲有喺用米精華。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
